summary: Piranha Bytes' post-Gothic action RPG trilogy, moving from Faranga's volcanic fantasy island to pirate-themed sequels and complete-edition DLC routes.

entries.title: Risen

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than emulating Xbox 360 or console ports.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with current compatibility fixes.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route; later PS4, Xbox One, and Switch ports add modern console availability but no documented exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release with official/current patches and available compatibility fixes; use the 2023 console ports only if controller-first convenience matters more than PC capture flexibility.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2023 PS4, Xbox One, and Switch ports improve modern console access but are not documented as adding exclusive story content.

entries.title: Risen 2: Dark Waters
entries.definitive_edition: Risen 2: Dark Waters Gold Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than emulating seventh-generation console versions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with all DLC installed.

primary.why: The Windows release is the best fidelity/capture route, and Gold Edition is the complete package with all DLC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Risen 2: Dark Waters Gold Edition on Windows through Steam/GOG or another current PC storefront, applying available compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Gold Edition is the complete route because it includes the DLC; no later remaster or platform-exclusive story content is documented.

entries.title: Risen 3: Titan Lords
entries.definitive_edition: Risen 3: Titan Lords Complete Edition with Enhanced Edition update on Windows

emulation.notes: Use native PC Complete Edition rather than emulating PS3/Xbox 360 or capturing PS4 unless console comparison is the goal.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with all DLC and enhanced update path.

primary.version: Risen 3: Titan Lords Complete Edition with Enhanced Edition update
primary.why: Windows is the best fidelity/capture route once updated, and the Complete Edition includes the base game plus all DLC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Risen 3: Titan Lords Complete Edition on Windows with the Enhanced Edition/update path applied and all DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS4 Enhanced Edition is a notable improved console release; confirm the PC build is updated and all DLC is installed before treating it as definitive.
